title: Remote code execution through AVIF image optimization
reason: Only reachable when Astro's Sharp image service optimizes an untrusted AVIF. This app never calls Sharp, uses no astro:assets or <Image>, stores verification uploads in R2 unprocessed, and Sharp cannot run inside a Cloudflare Worker; Sharp is a build-time dependency only. Fix requires Astro 7.2.8+ (we are on 5.x). Re-assessed and extended 2026-10-27: Astro 6+ needs @astrojs/cloudflare 13+, which drops Cloudflare Pages, so the upgrade is a move from Pages to Workers, scheduled before this expiry.
